final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.translink, step1.tradekind, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count AS ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count), AVG(ratio) FROM step3 GROUP BY tradekind
